title: Elections in Brazil and petroleum profile
author: Roque Leal
summary: Explore Brazil’s oil and gas market under Lula da Silva. Track pre-salt basins, Petrobras production, and live data on World Oil Map.
keyPoints: Lula, Petrobras and pre-salt basins drive Brazil's dominance as Latin America's top oil producer.
body:
The elections in Brazil result in Lula da Silva. In Brazil, did you know that the largest field was once called Campo Lula? Off the coast of Rio de Janeiro lies a horizon of energy opportunities for this great South American country, in this case pre-salt deposits rich in light oil. The largest oil company in Brazil is Petrobras. Brazil is Latin America's top oil producer, yielding 3,550 kbbl/d with 14.9 billion barrels in reserves, while Lula crude trades at $116.16/bbl. The sector spans 2,635 verified assets—dominated by Petrobras across key offshore basins like Santos and Campos—comprising over 1,200 blocks, active pipelines, and advanced deepwater pre-salt operations.

The booming Brazil oil and gas sector spans 2,635 verified assets—anchored by key offshore basins like Santos and Campos—comprising over 1,200 blocks, active pipelines, and advanced deepwater pre-salt operations.

title: World Oil Map November 2026 release
seoTitle: World Oil Map November 2026 Release: Global Oil Intelligence
author: Roque Leal
summary: Discover the November 2026 World Oil Map release. Explore advanced global oil & gas intelligence, new drilling layers, China coverage & live crude prices.
keywords: World Oil Map, global oil intelligence, oil and gas market intelligence, petroleum basin analysis, crude oil price monitoring, geospatial energy analytics, oil well datasets
keyPoints: Explore the November 2026 World Oil Map release featuring advanced global oil intelligence, expanded data layers, and live crude price monitoring.
body:
World Oil Map is evolving. In November 2026, a major new release marks a significant milestone in the way global petroleum data is accessed, analyzed, and visualized. This new chapter strengthens transparency and data-driven decision-making across the oil and gas industry through the integration of expanded data sources and advanced geospatial intelligence capabilities.
The latest update introduces a broader global coverage, enabling more detailed analysis of key energy regions, including the addition of petroleum provinces across the People's Republic of China. The platform also incorporates new layers of intelligence, such as drilling activity maps and oil well datasets, providing unprecedented visibility into exploration and production dynamics.
Powered by cutting-edge data integration and artificial intelligence, World Oil Map now offers a seamless analytical experience that bridges every level of the petroleum ecosystem. Users can move effortlessly from highly detailed well-level analysis to a comprehensive global overview of energy markets, including up-to-date crude oil price monitoring and market intelligence.
This release reinforces World Oil Map's position as a leading platform for:
•	Global oil and gas market intelligence
•	Petroleum basin and province analysis
•	Oil well and drilling activity visualization
•	Crude oil price monitoring
•	Geospatial energy analytics
•	AI-powered energy data visualization
•	Strategic exploration and production insights
Welcome to the New World Oil Map
We are excited to welcome users to this new phase of innovation. Over the coming weeks, we will be introducing each of the platform's new tools, datasets, and capabilities, demonstrating how intelligent spatial analysis can unlock deeper insights for the global oil and gas sector.
Whether you are an energy analyst, geologist, investor, operator, or decision maker, World Oil Map provides the advanced visualization and analytical capabilities needed to better understand the rapidly evolving energy landscape.
